## Choose when Nod prepares work

Automatic preparation checks supported app changes and can prepare a nudge or task. It starts off for new profiles; turn it on in **Settings → Notifications**. Gmail and Calendar use change checks, while other apps need supported events. Unchanged sources skip the monitoring model check. Routine changes wait through quiet hours; known urgent items with strong evidence may be checked. The separate $5 monthly allowance is adjustable in **Usage**. [How it works](https://nod.n8n.io/docs/how-it-works/proactivity/)

## See the commands behind a task

Open a task preview and select **Show commands** for its latest 200 workspace commands, exit status, and saved output. **Usage** includes the details and a CSV export. Nod removes known secrets, but output may contain private file content. Check exports before sharing them. [Watch Nod's commands](https://nod.n8n.io/docs/use/workspace/#watch-nods-commands)

## Find your reading size

Use **Settings → General → Appearance → Font size** to make the desktop view larger or smaller. It follows **View → Zoom** and remembers your choice.

## Also in this release

- Approval prompts ask a clear question and name the action instead of showing raw tool details.
- Gmail watches keep their place after a temporary Composio error. App discovery shows clear limit and outage reasons.
- On managed networks, the local engine uses private CAs trusted by your operating system for Composio HTTPS. Certificate checks stay on.
- Periodic app checks spread across the five-minute cycle while keeping their cadence.
